status: Matched probe-ON and probe-OFF live trials completed with the same application archive and two async workers; substantial diagnostic-cost evidence, with a residual 64.301-second attachment-to-ready gap.
limits: The original Oct30 kernel is not the matched baseline; causal comparison uses the separately built ON/OFF pair.
Both images use the same allocation algorithm and locks.
Kernel identity is publication+fresh-boot evidence; boot logs do not emit the kernel SHA.
Stripped kernels are checked through the exact compiled generated C ABI resolver and ABI declaration/lock identity, not an ELF symbol table.
One controlled pair is not a repeated benchmark.
One completed process per kernel setting, both after a fresh boot; not a statistical benchmark.
Both detailed heap tracing and allocation/free ABI breadcrumbs change together, so their individual costs are not separated.
Network/account/catalog behavior may vary between sequential trials.
Runtime maxima below use observer rows at or before first ready-frame, avoiding unequal post-ready windows.
Allocator coarse receipts may skip while the heap mutex is busy; missing rows do not mean no work.
First-flush and ready-frame are source markers; application clock starts after loading.

comparison.interpretation: The completed matched pair is evidence that allocation diagnostics materially affect this workload. This does not attribute CPU cost or isolate the individual diagnostic gates.
